def _t():

        pass
    self = _SelfNS()
    self.o = newstyle()
    self.n = newstyle()
    self.o2 = newstyle()
    self.n2 = newstyle()
    self.o.ind = -2
    self.n.ind = 2
    lst = list('ab!cdefghi!j')
    del lst[self.o]
    del lst[self.n]
    lst[self.o] = 'X'
    lst[self.n] = 'Y'

    lst.__delitem__(self.n)
    assert lst == [5, 6, 8, 9, 10, 11], ('assertEqual', lst, [5, 6, 8, 9, 10, 11])

class newstyle:

    def __index__(self):
        return self.ind

def _t():

    class _SelfNS:
        pass
    self = _SelfNS()
    self.o = newstyle()
    self.n = newstyle()
    self.o2 = newstyle()
    self.n2 = newstyle()
    self.o.ind = 2
    self.n.ind = 3
    lst = [6, 4]
    lst *= self.o
    assert lst == [6, 4, 6, 4], ('assertEqual', lst, [6, 4, 6, 4])
    lst *= self.n
    assert lst == [6, 4, 6, 4] * 3, ('assertEqual', lst, [6, 4, 6, 4] * 3)
    lst = [5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 11]
    l2 = lst.__imul__(self.n)
    assert l2 is lst, ('assertIs', l2, lst)
    assert lst == [5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 11] * 3, ('assertEqual', lst, [5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 11] * 3)
try:
    _t()
except BaseException as _e:
    print('ORACLE_EXC ' + type(_e).__name__ + ' ' + repr(str(_e)))
else:
    print('ok')
